record.question: The Union Public Service Commission is mandated to present report on its performance annually to:
record.explanation: Answer B: President. Article 323 requires the UPSC to submit its annual report to the President. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
